description: Returned by POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/realtime. Everything a browser needs to open a speech-to-speech session with the realtime vendor directly. The persona instructions are sealed into the minted credential vendor-side and are deliberately not included here.

client_secret.description: Ephemeral. Expires; scoped to one session.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

provider.description: Which talker: selects the browser's transport.
provider.title: Provider

call_url.description: POST the SDP offer here with the secret as bearer. Empty for providers whose SDK owns the endpoint.
call_url.title: Call Url

voice.description: Derived from the persona; stable across sessions.
voice.title: Voice

stt_source.description: Who transcribes the interviewer, for the UI's status line.
stt_source.title: Stt Source

noise_reduction.description: Vendor-side denoising profile; empty when the vendor applies none.
noise_reduction.title: Noise Reduction

client_config.description: Non-secret connect parameters the browser passes to the vendor SDK verbatim.
client_config.title: Client Config

title: RealtimeCredentialResponse
